title: How’s the GOP’s Golden Age Treating You?
author: George Ochenski
content:
[![](https://www.counterpunch.org/wp-
content/uploads/2026/07/IMG_2072-1-680x510.jpeg)](https://www.counterpunch.org/2026/07/27/hows-
the-gops-golden-age-treating-you/)

![](https://www.counterpunch.org/wp-
content/uploads/2026/07/IMG_2072-1-680x510.jpeg)

Glen Canyon Dam, near Page, Arizona. Photo: Jeffrey St. Clair.

It's late July in Montana, which should be the perfect time to be casting a
fly to rising trout on Montana's once-famous blue ribbon streams. Only every
day  _[more and more of those streams join the restricted or closed
list](https://fwp.mt.gov/news/current-closures-restrictions/waterbody-
closures)_ because there's so little water left and it's too hot for trout.

In the meantime, the Iran War drags on, despite Trump's claim it has already
been won 38 times -- surely enough to garner the Nobel Peace Prize the "no new
wars" president covets.

But not only hasn't the war been won despite the estimated $100 billion
drained from the Treasury, Trump is now asking Congress  _[for an additional
$60 billion in war funding.](https://apnews.com/article/iran-war-house-
republican-budget-47056fcf87e5937bd1bb3f9ae0388d37)_ It's now  _[expanded to
Yemen, where the Houthis have decided to close the Strait of al
Mandeb](https://www.cnn.com/2026/07/23/world/live-news/iran-war-trump)_ -
which was the only sea route still open to ship Gulf oil to the world -- and
just blew up a couple Saudi oil tankers to show they're serious.

When more dead American soldiers arrived home this week,  _[they were used as
political props by our deranged president who falsely put words in their dead
mouths,](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/donald-trump-fallen-troops-comment-
backlash_n_6a61addce4b0f1b7fc513b07?origin=home-latest-news-unit)_ claiming
they fully supported the disastrous war he started with his pal Benjamin
Netanyahu -- the same guy who has a warrant out for his arrest for committing
war crimes in Israel's on-going genocide in Gaza.

Oil is  _[now back above $100 a barrel](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/oil-
prices-rise-amid-us-iran-hostilities_n_6a61f860e4b0c2f78d020cc0)_ , and gas is
back over $4 a gallon nationally and going nowhere but up. Guess the war isn't
over, the straits aren't open, and there's no sign of inflation slowing down
since everything from liquid fuels to fertilizer to plastics runs on oil
derivatives…pure and simple.

As for the "gold" in Golden Age -- well, it's there alright. Not for you or me
or most Americans, who struggle with ever rising costs. But  _[a couple
billion in Saudi money to Jared
Kushner,](https://www.yahoo.com/news/politics/articles/jared-kushner-billion-
dollar-ties-234021381.html)_ Trump's son-in-law who, without a hint of
conflict of interest, somehow is also the negotiator for the US with the
Saudis.

Another  _[couple billion to the prez himself from a corrupt bribe scheme
masquerading as a crypto enterprise](https://www.theguardian.com/us-
news/2026/jul/01/trump-accused-one-billion-dollars-crypto-venture)_ that left
investors holding near worthless assets while the prez banked the gold. Plus,
his personal stock buys in the last year eclipsed the entire stock actions by
all the members of Congress. Stocks that he then went on to shamelessly
promote, saying "_[go out and buy a Dell
computer](https://www.yahoo.com/news/politics/articles/trump-bought-
over-1m-dell-210730433.html)_ " after he bought a million bucks worth of their
stock and  _[the firm was awarded a whopping $6.7 billion defense
contract.](https://www.war.gov/News/News-Stories/Article/Article/4502292/war-
department-signs-97b-technology-deal-with-dell-for-microsoft-services/)_

Then there's  _[Don Jr.'s and brother Eric's tidy $3.2 billion in
](https://www.yahoo.com/news/politics/articles/trump-sons-bet-big-
defense-151124180.html)_government contracts with another $3.1 billion in
future contracts. Add  _[$1.75 billion federal money backing for their mine in
Kazakistan](https://newrepublic.com/post/209840/donald-jr-eric-trump-military-
deal-mining-company)_ of your money in their pockets.

Here in Montana and the West, the "Golden Age" is rolling on with landscape
scale deforestation,  _[opening national monuments to oil, gas, and uranium
mining,](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/jul/13/trump-cuts-national-
monuments-utah)_ all without a shred of concern for the rapidly mounting
impacts from the baking climate.

The mighty Colorado River is now a trickle,  _[so low the Glen Canyon dam is
approaching dead pool](https://www.newsweek.com/lake-powell-should-be-drained-
to-save-lake-mead-scientists-say-12167251)_ -- when it will no longer generate
power or supply water for the 40 million Americans who rely on it.

If you're wondering if  _["the fish rots from the
head"](https://www.phrases.org.uk/meanings/fish-rot-from-the-head-down.html)_
the vast stench emanating from the White House should confirm beyond a doubt
that "the swamp" is full of rotting fish. The same rotting fish telling you
they're winning the Iran War, prices are falling, and we're rolling happily
along in the new Golden Age -- and if you believe that, I know where you can
get a good deal on Trump crypto coins.

The post [How's the GOP's Golden Age Treating
You?](https://www.counterpunch.org/2026/07/27/hows-the-gops-golden-age-
treating-you/) appeared first on
[CounterPunch.org](https://www.counterpunch.org).
